prompts.Samurai:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: proportion correction for the current adult female Samurai.
Image 1 is the edit target. Images 2, 3 and 4 are ONLY proportion and style baselines: the Monk, original Warrior and Barbarian. DO NOT use the Rogue as a reference.
The existing Samurai is much too elongated: tiny anatomical head, long neck, long narrow torso, long thin limbs. Redraw the SAME adult woman and SAME costume with compact proportions matching the baseline cast. This is an anatomical redraw, not simply resizing the whole existing figure.
Target about 5.25 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to soles. Measure the actual skull and chin; DO NOT count the high ponytail as part of head height. Make the facial/skull mass distinctly larger relative to torso, shorten the neck, shorten thighs and shins substantially, shorten arms and keep the torso compact. Hips around the middle of the figure, no fashion-model legs. Keep adult mature facial features, athletic shoulders and firm confident bearing; no baby face or chibi.
Preserve long black high ponytail, serious adult female identity, securely opaque ivory sarashi chest wrap, bare midriff and one bare shoulder, muted rust outer kimono worn on ONLY ONE arm, noticeable practical dark iron shoulder guard on the clothed shoulder, charcoal hakama trousers, wraps and sandals. Use fewer broader hakama folds rather than lengthening the cloth. The same normal katana held in her bare sword arm, angled downward outward, scabbard at hip. Keep weapon proportionate to the more compact adult figure. Balanced grounded standing three-quarter pose. No new ornaments or costume changes.
The result must look like she belongs beside the original Warrior and Monk in scale and visual proportions, visibly less tall and slender than Image 1.
Match ONLY the supplied Warrior / Monk / Barbarian baseline images for drawing language and body proportions. They are comparison references, not characters to include. Strong angular dark-fantasy cartoon, thick near-black outlines, broad clean flat cel-shadows, restrained muted colors, economical interior lines. Compact stylized ADULT body with substantial hands and feet. No gradient, glow, halo, dithering, small texture, painterly rendering, glossy anime rendering, or coarse pixelation. Single complete character only, transparent background, no scenery or ground shadow, no text or watermark. Native tall portrait canvas, comfortable margin around all extremities and equipment. Do not stretch the anatomy to fill the tall canvas: leave more empty space if necessary.
prompts.Wizard:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: new approachable elderly scholar Wizard design in the established game style.
Image 1 is a costume, personality and carried-equipment reference: a well-kept traveling scholar in a blue shoulder cloak over a red tunic, reading an open book. DO NOT copy its realistic rendering or realistic long proportions. Images 2, 3 and 4 are the ONLY drawing-style and compact-body-proportion baselines: Monk, original Warrior and Barbarian. Do not reference the Rogue.
An original clearly elderly male tower scholar around 65–70, grandfatherly and approachable, curious about the labyrinth. Warm attentive eyes, relaxed gentle eyebrows, soft subtle smile, swept-back silver-grey hair with a receding hairline, a neatly trimmed SHORT grey beard and moustache. A kindly intelligent adult face, not a scowling eccentric, villain, hook-nosed caricature, youthful hero, or enormous beard. Bare head, no wizard hat.
Well-maintained simple scholar-adventurer costume inspired by Image 1: muted dusty-blue short shoulder cloak draped asymmetrically, clean burgundy knee-length split tunic, plain brown leather belt, pale charcoal trousers and sensible leather boots. One restrained cream collar detail, intact hems, broad simple folds, no ornate gold embroidery or dangling strips. Fine tailoring conveys life in a tower, not rags or royal luxury.
He holds one open scholarly book comfortably in BOTH hands at chest level, glancing up from reading with friendly curiosity. A single SHORT DAGGER in a plain sheath fixed at the waist belt, clearly a dagger not a sword. A simple straight polished dark wooden STAFF is strapped diagonally ON HIS BACK, its modest wooden head visible above one shoulder and lower end beside the opposite hip/leg. The staff is not in either hand. The book, waist dagger and back-carried staff must each read clearly with minimal strap complexity. Keep the shoulder silhouette readable; no owl, familiar or extra props in this concept.
Compact adult proportions around 5.25 anatomical heads tall, matching the baseline cast. Head height is measured crown to chin, excluding beard. Short neck, larger expressive head, compact torso and moderate-length legs, sturdy hands and boots. Do not inherit the reference painting's long realistic anatomy. Friendly composed standing three-quarter pose. No exaggerated epic armor, giant gemstone, glowing magic or ornamental clutter.
Match ONLY the supplied Warrior / Monk / Barbarian baseline images for drawing language and body proportions. They are comparison references, not characters to include. Strong angular dark-fantasy cartoon, thick near-black outlines, broad clean flat cel-shadows, restrained muted colors, economical interior lines. Compact stylized ADULT body with substantial hands and feet. No gradient, glow, halo, dithering, small texture, painterly rendering, glossy anime rendering, or coarse pixelation. Single complete character only, transparent background, no scenery or ground shadow, no text or watermark. Native tall portrait canvas, comfortable margin around all extremities and equipment. Do not stretch the anatomy to fill the tall canvas: leave more empty space if necessary.

samuraiCorrection.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. SINGLE TARGETED PROPORTION FIX.
Image 1 is the same female Samurai to preserve. Image 2 is the Monk, the authoritative proportion baseline.
Image 1 still has a too-small anatomical skull and face relative to the full standing body. Correct it decisively: increase the SKULL AND FACIAL MASS about 20 percent relative to the torso, shorten the neck, and shorten the thighs/shins about 10–15 percent. Match Image 2's compact adult proportion, approximately 5.5 actual skull-crown-to-chin head lengths from crown to soles. Do NOT count ponytail, hair spikes or beard as anatomical head height. The actual face and jaw should be clearly larger; simply adding more ponytail volume is not the requested change.
Retain the SAME mature adult woman, face identity and stern expression, long black ponytail, trained adult shoulders, securely opaque ivory sarashi bust wrap, bare midriff, one bare shoulder, rust kimono on one arm, dark layered shoulder armor on the clothed side, charcoal hakama, sword/scabbard, wraps and sandals. Broader shorter hakama and shorter legs, larger readable face, substantial hands and feet, adult cartoon rather than cute baby/chibi. Keep original three-quarter stance, colors, thick angular black outlines and flat cel shading. Do not introduce new clothing or props.
Only her anatomy/proportions should change, not the costume or style. Full body with generous clear canvas margins; do not lengthen body or weapon to fill the vertical page. Transparent background, no halo, glow, gradient, fine grain, text, labels, scenery or ground shadow. One single finished character cutout, no Monk in output.
